def: AMD's line of data-center GPU accelerators, including the MI300X, MI325X, MI350X and MI355X, programmed through the open ROCm software stack.
practice: The MI350 series (2025) carries 288 GB of HBM3E at 8 TB/s and adds FP4 and FP6; vLLM and SGLang support it, though new kernels can arrive later than on CUDA.
